sloka: सीते मृतस्ते श्वशुर: पित्रा हीनो ऽसि लक्ष्मण ।भरतो दु:खमाचष्टे स्वर्गतं पृथिवीपतिम् ॥ २.१०२.१५॥
transliteration: sīte mṛtaste śvaśura: pitrā hīno 'si lakṣmaṇa ।bharato du:khamācaṣṭe svargataṁ pṛthivīpatim ॥ 2.102.15॥

translations.english: O Sita, your fatherinlaw is dead. O Lakshmana, you are deprived of your father. Bharata is relating to me the sad news that king Dasaratha has attained his heavenly abode.
